visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a black long-sleeved sweatshirt and blue jeans, stands in a professional studio environment. The background wall is black and prominently features a repeated tiled pattern of 'JKF' logos in red and white. He looks thoughtful, touching his chin and face as he attempts to recall information, with large yellow and black text overlays at the bottom. (2) The man points energetically toward the camera with a joyful expression as colorful confetti falls from above. Large yellow text reading '恭喜答對' appears in the center. He jumps and pumps his fists in celebration while several white 'WOW' speech bubble graphics pulse around him against the logo-covered background. (3) A young woman with brown hair tied in pigtails, wearing a black crop tank top labeled '1RE' and black leather pants, enters the frame from the right side. She stands with her hands on her hips, looking unimpressed and stern. The background environment shifts to a graphic red brick wall texture as she stares toward the man. (4) The man is now seen sitting on a dark brown tufted leather sofa, looking up at the woman with a sheepish and slightly intimidated expression. The woman continues to stand over him with her hands on her hips, maintaining a confrontational posture. In the final moments, stylized animated flames in yellow and red erupt behind her to visualize her anger.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male narrator voice introduces a contest over fast-paced electronic background music with a heavy synthetic beat. The primary male speaker then recites alphanumeric serial numbers in a clear, rhythmic tone with moderate intensity, exhibiting slight pauses as he thinks. (2) A sharp, high-pitched synthetic 'ding' sound effect triggers a transition into a peak celebratory phase. The audio mix becomes dense with synthesized crowd cheering, multiple layers of 'Wow' vocal effects, and a surge in music volume to emphasize high arousal. (3) The background music suddenly cuts to a clean studio silence, interrupted by a short electronic whoosh. A female voice begins speaking Japanese with a firm, falling intonation and a stern, berating tone. The speech rate is controlled and authoritative. (4) The male speaker responds in Mandarin with a much lower volume and submissive intensity, sounding hesitant. The scene concludes with a loud, broadband frequency 'fire whoosh' sound effect that masks the background, effectively punctuating the woman's anger for comedic effect.
